작품.저작자원문: Gerard de Lairesse
작품.설명원문: Selene and Endymion. Cupido holding a burning torch shows Selene (or Diana) the sleeping Endymion. Behind her the moon shines through the clouds. Mantlepiece commissioned between 1678 and 1682 for the bedchamber of Mary Stuart, later queen of England, at the hunting lodge of her husband, William III of Orange, the present Soestdijk Palace. For the two other surviving paintings by de Lairesse from this bedchamber, see File:Gerard de Lairesse 001.jpg and File:Gérard de Lairesse - Mercurius gelast Calypso om Odysseus te laten vertrekken.jpg.

Center: Discordia, helding some of the 110 flags captured by Michael the Brave and Giorgio Basta (left: Moldavia, right: Odorhei, center: Szigmond Bathory's flag). Right: Transylvanian prisoners sitting under a round shield with Transylvanian symbols: a hand, a bird, a donkey, a sheep. Left: goddess Diana, holding a spear with the imperial twin-headed eagle, under the Capricorn, emperor Rudolph II's astrological sign.

작품.설명원문:
Two photographs on album page

Caption to the right of top left photo: This also from a sketch, or painting, by Clarence Hanford. It is somewhat inaccurate. The west row of houses stood on the beach, the tide under several of them. The mill was opposite the first house near it. The house to south was on the point. Bark Brontes and U.S. ship Decatur are the vessels. Caption on image: Peiser 15. Battle of Seattle, 1856. Copyrighted C. Hanford 1895. Caption to the right of bottom left photo: Seattle from Madison Street to Union in 1870. The prominent buildings are Woodwards warehouse, Amos Brown's dwelling, M.P. Church, Central School, University, John Denny, W.H. Shoudy and other dwellings. Caption on image: Peiser 17, Seattle.

Photo on top left: Photograph of painting depicting Piner's Point, vicinity present-day King Street in 1852.

Prosch Washington Views Album, page 75

  • Subjects (LCTGM): Waterfronts--Washington (State)--Seattle
  • Subjects (LCSH): Seattle (Wash.)
Prosch attributes the drawing of the Battle of Seattle to Clarence Hanford, but others attribute it to Emily Inez Denny.

작품.제목: File:Obersöchering StPeter&Paul 013.jpg
작품.저작자원문: K.Baas
작품.설명원문: Obersöchering, Habacher Str/Kirchplatz, Pfarrkirche St. Peter und Paul: das Deckenfresco im Chorraum von Johann Sebastian Troger von 1789 (siehe Text im Sockel der Säule in der Bildmitte) zeigt in der linken Bildseite vor dem Hintergrund einer (Rund-)Kirche, die auf einem Felsen errichtet ist, wie Christus die Schlüsselgewalt an Petrus übergibt. Über der Kirche ist -blass aus den Wolken hervortretend- das Dreifaltigkeitssymbol sichtbar. In der rechten Bildhälfte wird das Damaskus-Erlebnis des Saulus dargestellt: der auferstandene Christus ruft den darniederliegenden Saulus auf, ihn nicht weiter zu verfolgen: „Saul, Saul, was verfolgst du mich?“  In der Folge dieses Ereignisses nahm Saulus den neuen Namen Paulus an.

작품.제목: File:Obersöchering StPeter&Paul 015.jpg
작품.저작자원문: K.Baas
작품.설명원문: Obersöchering, Habacher Str./Kirchplatz, Pfarrkirche St. Peter und Paul: das zentrale Deckenfresko des Langschiffes stammt ebenfalls von Johann Sebastian Troger aus dem Jahr 1789. Hier wird die Kreuzigung des Apostels Petrus und die Enthauptung des Apostels Paulus  unter Teilnahme zahlreicher Zuschauer   dargestellt. In der Bildmitte – unter der Dreifaltigkeit von Gott Vater, Gott Sohn und Gott Heiliger Geist- symbolisieren 3 Engelchen die wesentliche Aussage von Paulus: “Nun aber bleiben Glaube (Engel mit Anker), Hoffnung (Engel mit Kelch) und Liebe (Engel mit flammendem Herz), diese drei. Die Liebe aber ist die Größte unter ihnen.“

작품.제목: File:The Throne In Heaven 2021 Davin Arries b 1999 Oil on canvas Revelation Chapter 4 verse 1 to 11.jpg
작품.저작자원문: Davin Arries
작품.설명원문:
The Throne in Heaven 2021 Davin Arries b 1999 Oil on canvas, depicts the events of Revelation Chapter 4 Verse 1 to 11. The work is done with an immaculate and timeless technique and is inscribed in the bottom left, and is inspired by the following Biblical scripture : " Revelation 4:1–11 (NIV): 4 After this I looked, and there before me was a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had first heard speaking to me like a trumpet said, “Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this.” 2 At once I was in the Spirit, and there before me was a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it. 3 And the one who sat there had the appearance of jasper and ruby. A rainbow that shone like an emerald encircled the throne. 4 Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and seated on them were twenty-four elders. They were dressed in white and had crowns of gold on their heads. 5 From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings and peals of thunder. In front of the throne, seven lamps were blazing. These are the seven spirits of God. 6 Also in front of the throne there was what looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal.

In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, and they were covered with eyes, in front and in back. 7 The first living creature was like a lion, the second was like an ox, the third had a face like a man, the fourth was like a flying eagle. 8 Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around, even under its wings. Day and night they never stop saying: “ ‘Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty,’ who was, and is, and is to come.”

9 Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor and thanks to him who sits on the throne and who lives for ever and ever, 10 the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives for ever and ever. They lay their crowns before the throne and say: 

     11 “You are worthy, our Lord and God, 
        to receive glory and honor and power, 
        for you created all things, 
        and by your will they were created
and have their being.”

작품.제목: File:The Lamb and the first seal 2022 Davin Arries b 1999 Oil on canvas Revelation Chapter 6 verse 2.jpg
작품.저작자원문: Davin Arries
작품.설명원문:
The Lamb and the First Seal 2022 Davin Arries b 1999 Oil on canvas, depicts the events of Revelation Chapter 6 Verse 2. The work is done with a precise and indubitable oil to canvas technique, depicting clearly what the scripture describes. As is notable with Davin Arries he inscribes his signature in the bottom left. The piece serves as a continuation and builds upon "The Throne in Heaven 2021" piece with the twelves elders still visible, bowing down as described in the book of Revelation before God. God is more visibly apparent in this piece, appearing as described in Scripture, as having the appearance of Jasper and Ruby. As detailed in Revelation chapter 4 verse 1- 11.The work of art above depicts the events of the following Scripture: Revelation 6:2  (NIV)
2 I looked, and there before me was a white horse! Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he rode out as a conqueror bent on conquest.

작품.제목: File:'Oorlogsleed', woman and child at the Battle of Waterloo.jpg
작품.저작자원문: Jacobus Josephus Eeckhout
작품.설명원문:
The painting "Wartime Suffering" symbolizes and recalls the suffering that war brings. J.J. Eeckhout painted it in 1826. It is a classical, romanticized depiction in which the suffering of war is personified in a market woman. She mourns her fallen husband who lies at her feet. This soldier is a flanker from a Battalion of Infantry of Line of the Dutch force, which took part in the battle of Waterloo (1815). The drama is heightened by their child and by her skyward gaze. Her suffering is said to be based on the diary of one sergeant Jan Willem van Wetering who fought at Waterloo. It tells of a market girl who, shortly after giving birth to her child, searches desperately and in vain for her husband. According to his captain, he was still alive, but she did not believe him and insisted that her husband had perished.
This motif can be found, either centrally or as a detail, in the romanticized pictorial expressions of Napoleonic battles in the first half of the 19th century.
